correctness.rationale: Exact Fourier spectral decomposition yields five transition classes whose full-support two-angle product law has moments giving precisely 1/8 per class. The irrational ratio 2/sqrt(2) makes every positive physical-time tail dense in the two-angle torus. A full-support pushforward barycenter lies in the relative interior of the compact phase-image convex hull, so a dense physical orbit contains its exact convex representation. Affine normalization reduces dimension to at most four and Caratheodory to five times. No finite enumeration or computation is used to prove dense-orbit exact existence. The bundled standard-library checker verifies spectral identities in Q(sqrt(2)) and all five rational moments; instantaneous/Cesaro contrasts are separately exact.

value.rationale: The eight-cycle is a canonical eight-state cycle and the first higher power-of-two example after the four-cycle. Known impossible instantaneous and conventional average mixing made exact uniformity nontrivial; a nonstandard finite-time observation law completely overcomes both. The result is an exact positive answer for this natural graph with a uniform matrix on all 64 ordered pairs, an all-tail existence statement, and a concrete at-most-five-time resource guarantee. This is motivated by the arbitrary-law mixing program, rather than a gratuitous finite slice or mere recomputation of a known table.
